title: Rory and the Quiet Clover Hill
verses:
The sun dipped down behind the hill,
The valley breeze grew soft and still.
Then Rory stepped along the crest,
To find a place where all could rest.

While Nia drifted from the sky,
She watched the silver clouds go by.
And Psittaco began to peep,
"The clover blooms are fast asleep!"

Then Benny patted down the ground,
Without a thump or heavy sound.
And Tilly gathered fragrant leaves,
Beneath the swaying forest eaves.

Then Ricky gave a yawn so wide,
And tumbled onto Benny's side.
He curled his paws and closed his eyes,
Beneath the softly shining skies.

Now Rory tucked his tail in tight,
To share the warmth of starry night.
He heard the crickets start to play,
A lullaby to end the day.

The clover whispered soft and low,
As sleepy stars began to glow.
The tired friends were nestled deep,
All drifting off to peaceful sleep.
